Grizzly_Massive_Forelegs.description: Enormous, ursine forelegs bristling with thick, razor-sharp claws, capable of rending steel and splintering bones, embody raw, unyielding strength and resilience, enhancing both physical might and endurance while granting the wielder the ferocious skills of Claw and Sunder.

Polar_Bear_Thick_Paws.description: Enormous, frost-kissed paws tipped with razor-sharp claws, designed for gripping icy cliffs and slicing through water with unmatched precision, these bear appendages are a testament to sheer strength and resilience, granting their bearer both the power to cleave through foes and the ability to traverse the harshest of cold climates.

Black_Bear_Agile_Paws.description: The Black_Bear_Agile_Paws is a marvel of nature, its powerful claws and sinewy limbs granting it unmatched agility and strength, allowing it to scale sheer cliffs and deliver devastating claw strikes with deadly precision.

Panda_Bamboo_Grasping_Paws.description: Equipped with prehensile bamboo-grasping paws, these ursine appendages are marvels of dexterity and strength, enhancing both climbing agility and melee combat prowess, while granting the wielder unparalleled utility in combat and traversal.

Sun_Bear_Long_Clawed_Forelegs.description: These long-clawed forelegs, thick with sinew and muscle, are the hallmark of the sun bear, granting their wielder an unparalleled reach and dexterity, allowing them to scale sheer surfaces with prehensile grace and deliver devastating claw strikes that leave enemies reeling.

Sloth_Bear_Hook_Clawed_Paws.description: Equipped with razor-sharp, clawed paws that pierce through flesh with ease, these appendages are both a testament to the bear's raw strength and a formidable tool for climbing sheer cliff faces, dripping with blood and imbued with the power to inflict relentless bleeding wounds.

Spectacled_Bear_Adept_Forelegs.description: The Spectacled_Bear_Adept_Forelegs are formidable and dexterous limbs, tipped with razor-sharp claws that can grip and climb with unparalleled agility, granting their bear a fluid grace that belies their sheer mass and power.

Cave_Bear_Gigantic_Forelimbs.description: The Cave_Bear_Gigantic_Forelimbs component endows the creature with massive, heavily armored limbs brimming with raw strength, allowing it to deliver devastating claw attacks that can sunder weapons and knock down foes with sheer force.

Zombie_Bear_Rotting_Arms.description: The rotting arms of the zombie bear are festering appendages, thick with necrotic flesh and venomous fluids, capable of rending enemies with powerful claws while emitting a toxic cloud that poisons those nearby.

Spirit_Bear_Ethereal_Claws.description: The Spirit_Bear_Ethereal_Claws is an otherworldly appendage, a ghostly manifestation of a great bear's might, shimmering with a spectral luminescence that grants unparalleled stealth and arcane wisdom, its claws capable of rending through the veil of reality to strike unseen and unheard.
